parseDuration("1h30m") returns 5400.
A bare number with no unit, such as "90", is returned as that many seconds.
A decimal part is accepted, so "1.5h" returns 5400.
Upper-case unit letters are accepted, so "1H30M" returns 5400.
Units written smaller before larger, such as "30m1h", return null.
Text with an unknown unit, such as "1x", returns null.
